blocks.text: Experience clear audio for video meetings with a simple plug-and-play USB connection and a noise-canceling mic. Rigid left-sided mic boom is moveable and can be tucked out of the way when you're not using it. Handy in-line controls let you adjust volume or mute without interrupting calls. Fine-tuned drivers deliver enhanced digital audio for meetings, music, and more.

items.label: Rotating Noise Canceling Mic

items.label: Handy In-line Controls

items.label: Plug-and-Play USB Computer Headset
items.value: Simply plug the USB-A connector into your computer and you’re ready to talk or listen without the need to install software

items.label: Padded Comfort

items.label: Move Freely With Long Cable
items.value: The 6.23 ft (1.9 m) USB A cable is just the right length to give you the freedom to stand up and stretch during long conversations

items.label: Works With Chromebook
